A '''customs office''' was located within the [[Quartzedge Port]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]].<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], accompanied by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] members [[Erick]] and [[Flind]], searched the spaceport's docking bays and customs office for traces of [[Dors Stelikag]], an underling of the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], and his men.<ref name="COO" />
